performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat6 24AWG, 6.1 mm - a theoretical value for reference (FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet), both channels together, which states no fill

physical.mounting-hardware: Brackets x4, M6*15mm Screw x8 and M6 Nut x8

base.description: The dual finger duct as FS ships #63030, both sections stacked, all four covers fitted.

datasheet.title: FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet

description: 45U dual-sided vertical cable manager, FS SKU #63030: a black ABS finger duct with a hinged PVC cover on each face, 2108 mm tall in two 22.5U sections, that stands beside a 45U open-frame rack on four L-brackets. A moulded spine with eight oval pass-throughs carries a wall of fingers down each edge of each face, 23 a section at one rack unit apart, so it is two CMV-SFD45U5W channels back to back, one opening to the front of the rack and one to the rear, each 93 mm wide and closed by its own covers. It takes no rack unit.

gaps.note: the specification table gives 12 in and the dimensioned render 12.20 in (310); the side view prints 11.89 in [302mm], which is drawn. If the covers stand proud of the clips the extra 4 mm a face would explain it, but no view shows that.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the duct with its covers fitted, or a ruler on one

gaps.note: 16.80 kg (product page) is 3.5 times the single-sided 4.75 kg for what is, by the drawings, the same parts twice; about 9.5 would be expected. Possibly a shipping weight or a typing error. Stated as FS gives it.
gaps.wanted: the part weighed, or FS confirming the figure

gaps.note: two 1050 covers on the drawing make 2100; the table and the drawing note give 2108, as on CMV-SFD45U5W. No document says where the 8 mm is.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the assembled duct, or a ruler on a real one

gaps.note: where the L-brackets put the duct relative to the upright is not dimensioned for either 45U duct; the bracket sheet (VRTCMB, 45.2 wide) is the only figure. The duct is drawn without its brackets, which FS sells and draws as a separate part.
gaps.wanted: the AR201 upright and a dimensioned drawing of the bracket fitted

body.description: the back plates and the finger walls, the front channel first, left wall first

clips.description: the cover clips on the finger tips, six a wall in each section; the front channel first

cover.description: the hinged covers, one a section on each face; the front upper first, then the rear

fingers.description: the fingers, 23 a section; the front channel left wall top to bottom and then its right, then the rear channel

name: cmv-dfd45u5w

attrs.note: datasheet - style, materials (ABS backbone, PVC cover), colour, the detachable covers, the included brackets and fixings, the 45U open rack it matches and RoHS and ISO 9001 are the specification table and Standards Compliance list of the datasheet.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom end is the top end again: the side view is the same at both ends of a section.

capacity.note: datasheet - the cable capacity table of the same datasheet gives CMV-DFD45U5W per cable type and notes the copper figures are theoretical, for reference only; it states no fill. The figure stated is the Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm row, 5490, twice the single-sided 2745: FS states it for the manager, both channels together, and it is not divided between them.

chassis.note: drawing - THE DUCT AS IT STANDS, covers fitted: `width` across the rack face direction, `height` the height it runs, `depth` front to back. 138.8 wide is the cover over the 125.4 body, both read off the back and cover back views that this page shares with CMV-SFD45U5W (the table gives 4.9 in, 125). 2108 high is the table and the note on the drawing, 83 in. 302 deep is the side view, 11.89 in [302mm], clip face to clip face; see `depth`.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn in the CMV-SFD45U5W shades, the covers a shade lighter than the duct.

depth.note: drawing - 302 SETTLED FROM THE DRAWING. The specification table and the dimensioned render (x1) give 12 in and 12.20 in (310); the side view prints 11.89 in [302mm] overall and 10.83 in [275.1mm] between the finger tips, and both land on its features at one scale, so the drawing wins and the 8 mm is a `gaps:` entry. The single-sided duct agrees with its drawing (165 stated, 165.1 drawn), which is why the dual figure in the table is the one taken as rounded or wrong.

front.note: drawing - the front channel with its covers fitted, placed exactly as the CMV-SFD45U5W front: walls at 6.7 and 116.1, 23 fingers a section 44.44 apart, the first arm 13.03 below the top of the section plate. Pulled, a cover opens the 93.4 channel with the ovals in its floor.

guides.note: drawing - each channel is the 93.4 between its two finger walls, run down the height (`run: y`); its finger pitch is the 44.44 of the side view and its gap the 25.5 between arms, as on CMV-SFD45U5W.

left.note: drawing - the side view of page 5, both sections, rear at x=0: the spine with its bracket slots and bosses, and each half the CMV-SFD45U5W side view (wall roots, 46 arms and tips, twelve clips and the edge of the two covers), the rear half mirrored, with the joint a seam.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet (page 5) draws ONE 22.5U section of CMV-DFD45U5W three ways - a back view, a side view and a cover back view - and notes that the part is two of them, 83 in (2108mm) high. Its back view and its cover back view are the page 4 rasters of CMV-SFD45U5W byte for byte (the same embedded image twice, the same hash). The side view is a new raster, 800 x 1600, and orthographic: 1.169 px/mm across its 302 and 1.170 down its 1022.4. The product-page renders of #63030 are the second reading (g4 straight-on with the covers off, x1 dimensioned, g2 and g3 with the covers on, g5 and g6 close up on the channel).

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`, as CMV-SFD45U5W: the datasheet lists the same four brackets, eight M6 screws and eight nuts, the Quick Start Guide V3.0 covers both parts, and FS compatibility matrix accepts it on the APC AR201 45U two-post only. Here the keyed bracket slots are in the spine between the two channels, where the side view draws them, so the brackets go in from the side of the duct that faces the upright. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside. Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: drawing - the rear channel, the same parts placed the same way: the side view is symmetric about the spine, finger for finger and clip for clip, and the back view is symmetric about its centre line, so the rear channel seen from behind is the front channel seen from the front. Render g4 shows both rows of fingers with their covers edge-on. No `passes:` entry is declared on either face: the ovals join the two channels through the spine and reach neither outer face, as on fs/cmh-dfd1u.

reuse.note: drawing - EVERY PART IS THE CMV-SFD45U5W PART, ON BOTH FACES. The back view and the cover back view are the same rasters, so the back plate with its four ovals a section (fs/cmv-sfd45u5w-base@1) and the cover with its two hinge rails (-cover@1) are the same drawing. Measured on the side view against the page 4 side view, each half of the dual duct lands on the single-sided figures from its own clip face inward: the clip face to the tip front 13.7 against 13.6, to the back of the tip 25.7 against 25.4, to the slot roots 114.6 against 114.8, all within half a millimetre; the fingers (-finger@1), clips (-clip@1) and walls (-wall@1) are the same parts, placed exactly as on CMV-SFD45U5W, front view and rear view alike. The clips are on the 3rd, 5th, 11th, 13th, 19th and 21st fingers of a section on both faces, as there.

right.note: drawing - the left view mirrored: the duct is the same on both sides.

sections.note: estimated - THE TWO SECTIONS ARE DRAWN AS ONE LENGTH, the joint between them a seam, exactly as on CMV-SFD45U5W: each section half the 2108, 1054, its back plate 1022.4 centred in it and its covers 1054 high, so they meet at the joint.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX, as the horizontal dual duct fs/cmh-dfd1u is built. The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations; the solid is what its parts build: on each working face the back plate as a well 138.2 deep, its floor open at the eight pass-throughs, the two finger walls, 46 fingers a wall standing in it, 24 clips and two covers that pull off and open that channel. The two floors stand 25.6 apart in the middle of the part (see `spine`); plates sunk 0.05 inside the top, bottom and side faces close the spine between them, and the ovals run through it from one channel to the other.

spine.note: drawing - the side view draws a spine down the middle, its two faces 24.8 apart at the scale of the view (138.6 and 163.4 from one clip face). Two wells of the single-sided 138.2 inside the 302 leave 25.6, which is taken; the 0.8 between the two is under one pixel of the source. The spine carries two keyed bracket slots a section, 18.8 deep and 48.7 high on the side view, centred 177.4 and 844.2 below the top of the section plate (26.25 in [666.8mm] apart, the figure the view prints), and two pairs of round bosses either side of it, 19 across and 21 in [533.4mm] apart, centred 246.2 and 779.7 below the plate top; they are painted on the side faces.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states a wall gauge. 1.5 is the cover plate, as on CMV-SFD45U5W; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the end of the duct seen from above, rear at y=0: the CMV-SFD45U5W plan for the front half, shifted 136.9 back, and the same plan turned round for the rear half, with the spine 138.2 to 163.8 between them. No view draws the end; it is the side view figures laid across the back view widths.

weight.note: datasheet - 16.80 kg, the FS product page specification table for #63030, and RECORDED AS SUSPICIOUS: it is 3.5 times the 4.75 kg of CMV-SFD45U5W, which is the same moulding, fingers and covers on one face. Two of those would weigh about 9.5. Nothing else FS publishes states a weight for #63030; see `gaps:`.
